Title: Azure Maps Standard S1 transactions meter ID changes

Body.Content:
Starting November 1, 2019, some meter IDs for Azure Maps Standard S1 transactions will change.

This won’t affect pricing, but you’ll need to modify billing routines that rely on these meter IDs:
